ohaze-ss2d-seed42.reference_precision: Existing paper rounded values; old training reused

ohaze-ours-seed42.reference_precision: Existing paper rounded values; old training reused

macs_reference.convention: Fvcore MAC convention plus official state scan estimate 7*B*D*L*N, matching the paper convention of adding official scan operation estimates. Official merged depthwise 11x11 execution counts 121 MACs per channel/pixel. Scalar activations, gating and padding are not counted. Static operation count, not hardware time.

resources.timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized wall time around existing forward including tile assembly/clamp for tiled evaluation; excludes image decoding, H2D and quality metrics. Dataset evaluation wall time remains separate. No extra warmup/repeated images. Shared host contention and first-call overhead retained.
resources.memory_scope: PyTorch process allocated/reserved peaks in MiB; forward includes resident model and input/target tensors. Evaluation peak also includes metric workspace. Not whole-device NVML usage; reserved may include allocator cache from earlier calls.
resources.macs_scope: Reference batch1 RGB256x256 model MACs using recorded convention; per-image/tile call shapes also recorded. Do not treat reference MACs as a whole tiled evaluation count or measured hardware work.
